assault_rifle.name: Assault Rifle
assault_rifle.description: Standard-issue automatic rifle. Reliable at medium range.

combat_shotgun.name: Combat Shotgun
combat_shotgun.description: Devastating at close range. Accuracy drops sharply at distance.

sniper_rifle.name: Sniper Rifle
sniper_rifle.description: Long-range precision weapon. Poor in close quarters.

pistol.name: Service Pistol
pistol.description: Compact sidearm. Low damage but cheap to fire.

smg.name: Submachine Gun
smg.description: High rate of fire, low accuracy. Best at close-medium range.

combat_knife.name: Combat Knife
combat_knife.description: Silent melee weapon. High crit chance at point-blank.

plasma_cutter.name: Plasma Cutter
plasma_cutter.description: Industrial tool repurposed for combat. Burns through armor.
